manifest_hash_validation.mechanism: self-digest sha256 over canonical JSON with the digest field removed; route_digest() is the single recomputation point
manifest_hash_validation.fail_closed: get_capture_poses_after_validation returns (None, ['route_manifest_digest_mismatch']) before any ego/sensor/map work

sequence_validation.rules: no duplicate sequence_index; sequence_index must be sorted

coordinate_frame_binding.defect: frame identity was compared as raw strings ('EPSG:25832' vs '+proj=utm +zone=32 ...'), which can never be equal, so both_maps_share_exact_frame was structurally always False; the manifest was also never checked against itself
coordinate_frame_binding.fix: canonical_crs_identity() resolves EPSG codes and PROJ strings to canonical EPSG (lazy pyproj); unresolvable is None and treated as fail-closed, never as a match

set_transform_verification.mechanism: execute_route_strict commands ego.set_transform(carla.Transform), ticks once, reads get_transform() back and compares
set_transform_verification.api_requirement: actor must expose set_transform; apply_transform alone is rejected as ego_actor_missing_set_transform

position_yaw_tolerances.note: No tolerance was widened anywhere in this integration.

fatal_route_execution_failure.mechanism: any set_transform raise, world.tick raise, unreadable observed transform, or tolerance breach returns immediately with a failure reason and stops at that pose; verification does not continue

new296_live_route_adapter.reason: requires a real CARLA server to drive the paired route and read back transforms; CARLA RPC 2000 unreachable (see LIVE_RUNTIME_STATUS.json)
